instruction: A candid studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white wall, the smiling redhead woman (R1) stands on the left, wearing a brown top under a light blue shirt tied at the waist and beige trousers, looking towards her friend with a wide, joyful smile. Beside her on the right, the laughing woman with dark hair (R2) wears a white wrap blouse and light trousers, leaning slightly forward with her left hand resting on her stomach as she laughs heartily with her eyes closed. The two stand side-by-side, sharing a genuine moment of laughter. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a warm, clean color palette with a shallow depth of field.

R2 laughs with eyes closed while leaning slightly forward
